cases.question: If a prospective cast member says they have been in prison, should I disqualify them before the call, and what should I tell them?
cases.goldAnswer: Disqualify and send the rejection letter. You do not need to volunteer the reason; if they ask why, explaining it is optional.
forbiddenConcepts: continue the call and automatically approve

cases.question: Can I get a link to an example of Cast Member HQ to show prospects?
cases.goldAnswer: There is not a shareable example yet. Rich and Raul recently had sharing accounts created, and access should be available to reps soon.

cases.question: A Next Level CEO applicant is in a divorce and cannot use the lowest approved payment option right now. Can I create a cheaper custom plan, or can the applicant reschedule?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not create a custom plan or tell them how to move money. The listed option is the lowest approved option. Because this is a Daymond John applicant, the ISTV cohort deadline does not apply and they can reschedule for the next few weeks.
requiredConcepts: reschedule in the next few weeks

cases.question: Can I follow up with old no-show, cancelled, or ghosted Next Level CEO leads and invite them to recast for Built For More?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. Rich approved following up with those old Daymond John leads for Built For More.

cases.question: Does an ISTV cast member get distribution on all three Tier 1 platforms, or only one?
cases.goldAnswer: The goal is placement on one Tier 1 platform. The cast member does not choose the platform; the episode may be submitted to the other platforms if a submission is turned down.
requiredConcepts: submit to another if turned down

cases.question: Should a DJ rep use a different script for Built For More, or the Next Level CEO script?
cases.goldAnswer: Use the same script as Next Level CEO for Built For More.

cases.question: Can a prospect record our sales call on Zoom?
cases.goldAnswer: No. A prospect cannot record the sales call on Zoom.

cases.question: Three business partners want to appear together, but only one auditioned. Do they need separate episodes?
cases.goldAnswer: They can be in one episode. Put the details in the onboarding form and cover them during onboarding, with all partners involved in the decisions.

cases.question: Who works with a cast member after I close them: another casting agent or the production team?
cases.goldAnswer: After the sale they move into onboarding and work with production. The closer remains the casting agent; they are not handed to another casting agent.
forbiddenConcepts: a new casting agent is assigned

cases.question: Can we sell the webpage and social rebrand separately as a bolt-on to a lower package?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Those deliverables are included in the VIP offer and are not an approved bolt-on to another offer.
forbiddenConcepts: yes, add it to any package

cases.question: How many subscribers does Inside Success TV have, and can I share that number with a prospect?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not share a subscriber count. It is internal information and the sales team does not have or disclose that number.

cases.question: Are Money Mondays still active, what do they cover, and where should I send a client for more details?
cases.goldAnswer: Money Mondays are active and can start after the applicant joins the network. They cover using the reuse license and marketing guidance. They are live group sessions; recordings provide background. For current logistics or the live link, use Fulfillment or Marketing because Sales does not control that access.
requiredConcepts: Fulfillment or Marketing for current access

cases.question: A prospect wants the standard contract emailed before deciding. Should I email it or review it with them on the call?
cases.goldAnswer: Review and screen-share the contract on the call; do not promise to email it for offline review.
